portInfo.description: The city links a working passenger harbour to Roman/punic archaeology, a Romanesque basilica and nearby sandy beaches. San Paolo’s tiled dome and the archaeological museum provide different city stops; Sa Testa and Pittulongu require road transport. Porto Cervo is a separate resort/call, not another Olbia tender landing.

climate.description: Mediterranean climate with hot, dry summers and mild winters

politics.visaRequirements: Entry and visa rules depend on nationality. Many visitors use Schengen short-stay rules, but requirements change—confirm with official government sources and your cruise line before travel.
politics.entryRequirements: Carry a valid passport (or a national ID where your cruise line and destination authorities accept it). Cruise transit formalities can differ from a normal airport entry—follow your ship’s document list.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Use the ship/port-authorized exit or shuttle rather than assuming pedestrians can cut through the secure pier. Budget 45 minutes to the city museum area and 45–60 minutes for the correct-pier return. For Pittulongu or Sa Testa, retain a road return and confirm any site/beach access. The allowances are not measured walking distances.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Archaeological Museum of Olbia — Peddone islet, Olbia waterfront. Maritime archaeology anchors a port-town visit; current museum access needs checking. Allow 90 minutes; official source.
Basilica of San Simplicio — San Simplicio basilica, central Olbia. A Romanesque religious monument; worship may restrict the interior. Allow 45 minutes; official source.

San Simplicio necropolis museum — Necropolis below/by the San Simplicio church area, Olbia. A distinct underground archaeological attraction, not the basilica itself; opening unverified. Allow 45 minutes; official source.
Church of San Paolo — San Paolo church, Olbia historic centre. The tiled dome is an architectural sight even without interior access. Allow 30 minutes; official source.
Sa Testa sacred well — Sa Testa archaeological site, Olbia outskirts. Requires a road stop and a current access check. Allow 45 minutes; official source.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: If the ship uses Cocciani Sud, do not wait for it at an Isola Bianca shuttle point. The exceptional assignment is explicitly allowed by the ordinance but remains conditional, not a routine terminal substitution.
